fields.label: Supplier prices and freight
fields.placeholder: e.g. wax, jars and wicks from one supplier, freight $9 per order

fields.label: Active minutes and hourly pay
fields.placeholder: e.g. 45 minutes of hands-on work per candle, paying myself $15 an hour

fields.label: Packed weight and parcel size
fields.placeholder: e.g. 1.5 lb in a 6 x 6 x 6 in box

fields.label: Destination and shipping quote
fields.value: USPS Ground Advantage, shipped within the US

fields.label: Fees and ad mix

en.template: Help me price an Etsy candle for {location}, using {recipe}, {supplier}, {labour}, {parcel}, {shipping}, {fees}, {fixed} and {goals}. Show what remains after labour, cash needed upfront, shipping and ad stress cases, and what I should confirm before selling. Plan only; do not buy, contact sellers or publish.

phases.title: Check current prices from candle suppliers, Etsy’s fee page, USPS postage and Ohio tax guidance
phases.note: Supplies, fees, postage and sales tax
phases.judgment: It would not call a price confirmed when it was not: a shipping box was marked as an unverified pack size, and the wick as a stand-in price until it is burn-tested.

phases.title: Build an editable pricing workbook with a one-page guide and a source list
phases.note: Costs, fees, three price points and monthly break-even; competitor listings gathered alongside
phases.judgment: A colleague pulled back its own competitor prices after finding they had no real backing: zero fully verified comparables on the first pass, so it re-read the listings and reported only what it could see.

phases.title: Recalculate everything and check the files before handing over
phases.judgment: The summary states the limit up front: competitor prices are observations from public listings, not eight confirmed offers of the same size, and postage must be re-checked for January.

workers: Looked up current supplier prices for wax, wicks, fragrance, jars, labels and shipping boxes
Read public Etsy candle listings for a competitor price scan, then corrected its own first draft
Checked the calculator’s formulas on their own and caught a false “needs more hours” warning when labour time is zero

zh.askTitle: 换成你自己的蜡烛，得到同样的“付完人工还剩多少”核算
zh.runTitle: 俄亥俄州手作爱好者 2027 年 1 月在 Etsy 卖大豆蜡烛：扣掉人工、平台费和邮费后还剩多少

fields.label: 地点和开售日期
fields.value: 俄亥俄州，2027 年 1 月开卖

fields.label: 供应商价格及运费
fields.placeholder: 例如：蜡、杯子、灯芯同一家供应商，每单运费 9 美元

fields.label: 有效工作分钟和时薪
fields.placeholder: 例如：每支蜡烛实际动手 45 分钟，给自己每小时 15 美元

fields.label: 包裹重量和尺寸
fields.placeholder: 例如：1.5 磅，装进 6 x 6 x 6 英寸的盒子

fields.label: 目的地及邮费报价
fields.value: 美国境内，走 USPS Ground Advantage

fields.label: 平台费用和广告占比
fields.placeholder: 例如：15% 的订单来自 Etsy 广告

zh.template: 请按{location}、{recipe}、{supplier}、{labour}、{parcel}、{shipping}、{fees}、{fixed}、{goals}，帮我算 Etsy 蜡烛价格。分清付人工后还剩多少、前期要备多少现金，以及运费和广告更不利时会怎样。提醒我开卖前该确认什么。只做计划，不购买、不联系卖家、不发布。

phases.title: 查蜡烛供应商的最新报价、Etsy 收费页、USPS 邮费和俄亥俄州税务指引
phases.note: 材料、平台费、邮费和销售税
phases.judgment: 没核实的东西不当成已确认：运输盒的整包规格标成“未核实”，灯芯价格也注明只是暂代，要等试烧后才能定。

phases.title: 做可编辑的定价表，配一页说明和来源清单
phases.note: 成本、费用、三档售价和每月保本量；同时收集同类商品
phases.judgment: 一位同事发现自己交的同类商品价格站不住脚，主动撤回：第一轮没有一条完全核实的可比价格，于是重新逐条查看，只报告能亲眼看到的内容。

phases.title: 全部重新计算，核对文件后再交付
phases.judgment: 总结开头就说明了局限：同类商品的价格只是公开页面上看到的情况，不是八个确认过同规格的报价；邮费到一月份还要重新核对。

workers: 查蜡、灯芯、香精、杯子、标签和运输盒的最新供应商价格
读 Etsy 上公开的蜡烛商品页做同类价格对比，并更正自己交的第一版
独立核对计算表的公式，查出人工时间填 0 时会误报“工时不够”
